title: ErasureRequested
description: Erasure was requested for a subject. Event logs are append-only, so erasure is performed by destroying the per-subject data key rather than by rewriting the log. Evidential rather than audit, because it names the subject.

erasure_id.description: Erasure identifier. The join to the audit attestation.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. Subject whose data keys are to be destroyed.

basis.description: Basis for the erasure. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

items.description: Domain in scope. Only domains that carry pseudonyms can appear: traffic and telemetry are anonymous and vision uses track_ref. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

scope.description: Domains the erasure covers. Absent means every domain.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
